subject: POC alignment: success criteria & kickoff scheduling
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finlytics.com>; procurement@finlytics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-04T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC alignment: success criteria & kickoff scheduling

Hi Samir — thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned before the kickoff: 

Summary of what we heard
- Objective: Validate Redwood can reduce average inference cost by 40% for your document-parsing pipeline while meeting a 200ms p95 generation latency for single-document lookups.
- Key workload: ~60 QPS during peak business hours, mixed short prompts (avg 120 tokens) + occasional long-context retrieval (up to 8k tokens).

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Latency: p95 <= 200ms for standard lookup flows (100–200 tokens) under a steady-state 60 QPS.
2) Cost: >= 35% reduction in per-token inference cost vs current baseline (reported in your notes as $0.017/token).
3) Quality: F1 >= 0.84 on your curated validation set of 1,200 labeled examples (we’ll run initial evals with your seed set).
4) Integration: secure S3 access + internal user auth flow works without schema changes to your ingestion pipeline.

Ownership and roles (proposed)
- FinLytics: Samir (technical lead), Procurement (contracts/PO).
- Redwood: Evelyn (AE, overall), Marissa (CS, onboarding & acceptance tests), Ben (solutions eng, infra & deployment).

Timeline (tentative)
- Week 0 (Nov 17): Contract + PO in place.
- Week 1 (Nov 24): Kickoff + env access (data staging + S3 keys).
- Weeks 2–4 (Dec 1–Dec 19): POC run (integration, baseline runs, tuning).
- Week 5 (Dec 22): Final readout & decision.

Action items (owned):
- Samir: confirm the success criteria above and share the validation set sample by EOD Tue (11/6).
- Procurement: share PO process and expected timing.
- Ben: I’ll share a short deploy checklist and requested IAM roles before EOD Mon.
- Marissa: I’m attaching a draft SOW and an initial evaluation sheet for your review.

Attachments: Redwood_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft), FinLytics_POI_SuccessCriteria.xlsx (example evaluation template).

If this looks good I’ll book the kickoff for Nov 24 (45–60m). Prefer mornings PT — are you available 11/24 or would 11/26 be better?

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(e) evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | (m) +1 415-555-0123

Thanks for the recap, Evelyn — this is very helpful. Confirming the high-level criteria look right to us. A few clarifications and notes from our side: 

- Latency: 200ms p95 is acceptable for the lookup flows. For the long-context retrievals we expect higher variance — if possible, can we capture p50/p95 for both short and long flows separately?
- Cost: Our baseline $0.017/token is an internal blended figure — we’d like Redwood to measure cost both with and without KV caching enabled so we can see the unit economics in both modes.
- Quality: We’ll upload a 200-sample extract of the validation set tomorrow; Marissa will coordinate for the full set.
- Data access: We can provide a read-only S3 bucket and a sanitized subset for initial tests. Full dataset access will require an internal compliance review (2–3 business days).

Procurement note: procurement@finlytics.com — we prefer standard PO (net 30) and will need the SOW to finalize. Please add a short appendix on data handling and retention.

Kickoff availability: I’m available 11/24 morning PT. If we can do 11/24 9:30–10:15 PT that works.

Samir
Head of Data Products | FinLytics
samir.patel@finlytics.com
